rows.Kwic: 莫認頑空便為自己，洞山五位曲為今時，不究根源妄生階塹。
rows.sourceTitle: 明州天童景德禪寺宏智覺禪師語錄

rows.Kwic: 南泉一日兩堂爭貓，泉提起貓云：「道得即不斬。」眾無對，泉斬貓為兩段。南泉舉問趙州，州脫鞋戴出，泉云：「子在，救得貓兒。」
rows.sourceTitle: 明州天童景德禪寺宏智覺禪師語錄

ActorAttribution.ActorLabel: unnamed monks of the two halls

Override.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Hongzhi Jue at Tiantong Jingde Chan Monastery (明州天童景德禪寺宏智覺禪師語錄), in a case later versified by Hongzhi Zhengjue. The unnamed monks of the two halls are the collective actors contending over the cat; Nanquan Puyuan raises and cuts the cat, and Zhaozhou Congshen later puts a sandal on his head. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel passages do not name the monks of either hall.
